ORDER APPROVING AMENDMENT TO INTERCONNECTION AGREEMENT 
This Amendment to the Interconnection Agreement (the “Amendment”), negotiated between 
ATT&T Tennessee (“ATT&T TN”) and E. Ritter Communication, LLC (“CLEC”) pursuant to 47 
U.S.C. §251 and §252, was filed with the Tennessee Public Utility Commission (the “Commission”) 
on January 17, 2025.1 The Amendment has been reviewed, and no portion discriminates against a 
telecommunications carrier that is not a party to the agreement. 
A Notice was filed by the Commission on February 24, 2025, informing the public that the 
Amendment would be deemed approved by the Commission within ten (10) days of the filing of the 
Notice unless an objection to the Amendment was filed with the Commission. No objection to the 
Amendment was received by the Commission. 
Pursuant to the Notice and absent any objection having been filed with the Commission, the 
Amendment is approved effective as of March 6, 2025. 
ATTEST: 
_____________________________________ 
Earl R. Taylor, Executive Director 
1 CCN was granted in Docket No. 13-00094.
